boundary_rule: Native constituency geometry is preserved. Pre-2011 91/95-district outcomes may enter national and native legal layers immediately, but territorial models require an explicit forecast-eligible bridge to the frozen 2011-reference geometry; fuzzy row dropping/duplication is forbidden.
seat_rule: No exact seat forecast from standardized 9-bucket shares. Exact legal allocation requires the real list universe; 2021/2026 additionally require registered-voter counts and absolute votes.
temporal_rule: For target election Y, a forecast generator may open only artifacts whose information timestamp is strictly before Y's poll and historical outcomes with year < Y. The target outcome is opened only by the scorer after the forecast artifact is frozen.
